WHY HOSPITALSOFTWERE

A focused foundation for the work you do every day.

HospitalSoftwere is planned around the practical needs of diagnostic center teams: registering patients, billing tests, following samples, and preparing reviewed reports.

The core software is offered free for one center with one active branch. Installation, hosting, training, and support arrangements are discussed separately.
